replay.entry: mixdog-ai/src/service/error_presentation_replay_tests.rs: E/T probes as the ProviderError an adapter classifies (retry::classify::kind_of over the typed fields, mixdog-ai/src/retry/classify.rs:142), Q probes as the cache warm's refused POST (providers/anthropic/errors.rs classify_response + quota_error_text, now pub(crate)), S probes as a bare string; each through present_error_text (service/error_text.rs:174), safe_error_details (:346) and Descriptor::of (the errorKind failure_record persists); deterministicKinds through ErrorKind::is_deterministic.

inputs.clock: the current time (new Date(), Date.now) is the fixed instant 1800000000000 = 2027-01-15T08:00:00.000Z for the whole run; a replay must give the code under test this instant
inputs.locale: not read: no Intl or toLocale* on these paths; toDateString is locale-independent
inputs.timeZone: UTC: the reset wording ("09:00", "1/15 09:00") is the local time of resetAt, and the month/day prefix appears when its local day differs from the current local day; a replay must run with this zone

missingOnO1: providerErrorKind over an error object and the DETERMINISTIC_KINDS list: kind_of takes Facts, no constant list of deterministic kinds

normalised.socketErrors: Node's errno text is the core's typed TransportFault: an E probe with code ECONNRESET is built with fault_from_io(ConnectionReset, after connect) and the T probe (undici `TypeError: fetch failed`) with fault_from_io(ConnectionRefused, connecting) (mixdog-ai/src/transport/fault.rs:18); kind_of reads the fault, never the code text
normalised.secretShapedInput: sk-DUMMY- marker in the redaction case (the fixture secret scan refuses the original shape)
normalised.timeZone: recorded with TZ=UTC (the reset wording is local time); resetAt = the fixed clock + 1 h
